name: io.github.sepehr071/taaghche-mcp
title: Taaghche
description: Unofficial read-only Taaghche: search Persian ebooks and audiobooks, compare prices, read reviews.

environmentVariables.name: TAAGHCHE_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for requests to taaghche.com, or a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next. System proxy settings are ignored.
